page.title: Mayhem 1
page.t:
You don't own this sector.

If you claim this sector for you, you'll have to pay a fee and place a Sanctuary that will take some time to be fully built. You will also gain 1 threat.
If you claim this sector for another race \(rank 7 required\), you won't pay any fee and you won't gain any reputation points, but your threat level will not increase.
You can also unclaim this sector to make it Unknown, for free.

Reminder: Threat increases the strength of the OCV and all Battle Groups. Tread lightly.

Abandoning, unclaiming or giving away a sector will deny you the right to recapture it for 6 hours.

You own this sector.

If you abandon it, all your stations will be destroyed.
If you give this sector to another race, all your stations will be transferred and you gain 1 \033MFavor point\033X.
If you transfer this sector to the Xenon your infamy rises.
In all cases, all your ships will get undocked and station credits will be wired into your main account.
[author][green]%s Expansion Minister[/green][/author]In the name of our leader, please accept our warmest thanks for helping us expanding our empire.
[author][green]%s Expansion Minister[/green][/author]Your compliance is noted. This sector meets our demands. As agreed, we grant you a Non-Aggression Pact for the next %s hours.
